''' Related NPCs: ''' | Giants |} Kindly faction is required for all Thurgadin armor quests.
== Reward == {{Gear Set |Runed Protector's Helm |Runed Protector's Breastplate |Runed Protector's Vambraces |Runed Protector's Bracer |Runed Protector's Gauntlets |Runed Protector's Greaves |Runed Protector's Boots }} == Checklist == Turn-ins to [[Battlepriest Daragor]] in [[Thurgadin]].{{CheckboxList}} *[[Runed Protector's Helm]] :*[[Corroded Plate Helmet]] :*3x [[Crushed Coral]] *[[Runed Protector's Breastplate]] :*[[Corroded Breastplate]] :*3x [[Flawless Diamond]] *[[Runed Protector's Vambraces]] :*[[Corroded Plate Vambraces]] :*3x [[Flawed Emerald]] *[[Runed Protector's Bracer]] :*[[Corroded Plate Bracer]] :*3x [[Crushed Flame Emerald]] *[[Runed Protector's Gauntlets]] :*[[Corroded Plate Gauntlets]] :*3x [[Crushed Topaz]] *[[Runed Protector's Greaves]] :*[[Corroded Plate Greaves]] :*3x [[Flawed Sea Sapphire]] *[[Runed Protector's Boots]] :*[[Corroded Plate Boots]] :*3x [[Crushed Black Marble]] {{End}} == Walkthrough == You say, 'Hail, Battlepriest Daragor' : Battlepriest Daragor says, 'Greetings to you. I seek the service of devout knights who have distinguished themselves. Are you a paladin, ______?' You say, 'I am a paladin.' : Battlepriest Daragor says, 'A paladin of your kind has not made it this far for quite some time. Well, I wonder what it is you seek here? Do you seek heroic and chivalrous deeds to distinguish yourself from your brethren? Do you need accoutrements to aid you in your battles perhaps? You are in luck, knight, for I have both for you. Do you wish to partake of my quests?' You say, 'I wish to partake of your quests.' : Battlepriest Daragor says, 'Excellent! By serving my cause, you, in turn, will further your own. I require certain components and if you bring them to me I shall reward you for your honorable service. You may choose from among these items: a helm, a breastplate, armplates, bracers, gauntlets, greaves, and boots.' '''After turn-in:''' Battlepriest Daragor smiles warmly as he hands you your reward. 'You have done well, _____.'
* Your faction standing with [[Coldain]] got better. * Your faction standing with [[Dain Frostreaver IV]] got better. * Your faction standing with [[Kromzek]] got worse. * Your faction standing with [[Kromrif]] got worse.
{{YouGainExperience}} == Helm == You say, 'I choose a helm.' : Battlepriest Daragor says, 'To create a piece of armor to protect your skull I will require three pieces of [[Crushed Coral]] as well as a [[Corroded Plate Helmet]].' == Breastplate == You say, 'I choose a breastplate.' : Battlepriest Daragor says, 'For the breastplate, I will need a [[Corroded Breastplate]] and three [[Flawless Diamond]]s. Once I have them in my possession it will not take long to craft a sturdy breastplate.' == Sleeves == You say, 'I choose armplates.' : Battlepriest Daragor says, 'Protection for your arms will come at the price of a set of [[Corroded Plate Vambraces]] and three [[Flawed Emerald]]s.' == Bracer == You say, 'I choose bracers.' : Battlepriest Daragor says, 'For the bracers, I will require a [[Corroded Plate Bracer]] and a set of three [[Crushed Flame Emerald]]s. Return to me if you happen to find these things in your travels.' == Gauntlets == You say, 'I choose gauntlets.' : Battlepriest Daragor says, 'Protecting your hands is very important. I can forge protection for your hands if you bring me a pair of [[Corroded Plate Gauntlets]] and three [[Crushed Topaz]].' == Leggings == You say, 'I choose greaves.' : Battlepriest Daragor says, 'A set of [[Corroded Plate Greaves]] might be salvageable if you were to find three [[Flawed Sea Sapphire]]s. With the right techniques almost anything is possible.' == Boots == You say, 'I choose boots.' : Battlepriest Daragor says, 'Boots made for battle are not always the most comfortable available. However, if you seek a fine set for battle bring me a set of [[Corroded Plate Boots]] and three pieces of [[Crushed Black Marble]].'
